name: purchase_supplier
summary: Supplier identity, onboarding, documents, banks, qualifications, controlled changes and risk
description: Authoritative supplier governance for the Procurement module. Layers procurement identity, onboarding workflow (draft to active with suspended/blocked/expired states), site/contact/item master data, document expiry monitoring with revalidation reminders, restricted bank-account management with independent verification of sensitive changes, category-based qualification that gates sourcing eligibility, controlled profile-change requests, and explainable risk assessments. Supplier identity remains on the shared partner record and is never duplicated; this module owns only the procurement-specific attributes and their audit trail. Physical goods stay owned by Inventory and payables by Accounting.
author: Nexa
